01.hook: You will graduate soon. Graduate as a lawyer who already drafts contracts for businesses.
01.support: Draft one contract a day, from an NDA to a co-founder agreement, and learn the questions to ask a client before you start.

02.banner: FOR LAW GRADUATES WHO ARE NOT PRACTISING YET
02.hook: You have the law degree. Now become the lawyer startups hire to draft their contracts.
02.support: Learn the documents founders sign: co-founder agreements, ESOP plans, SAFE agreements and term sheets.

03.hook: You have your enrolment. Now build your first practice by drafting contracts for businesses.
03.support: Draft NDAs, employment agreements and vendor contracts, and learn how to pitch to the startups that need them.

04.banner: FOR JUNIOR ADVOCATES IN LITIGATION CHAMBERS
04.hook: You spend your days in court corridors. Now become the lawyer businesses call to draft their contracts.
04.support: Contract work is done at a desk, on your own hours: SaaS agreements, commercial leases and vendor contracts.

05.banner: FOR PARALEGALS AND LEGAL ASSISTANTS WITH AN LLB
05.hook: You prepare the files for the lawyer. Now draft the contract yourself, as the lawyer.
05.support: Learn to spot missing clauses and red flags with AI, then draft the clause that fixes them.

06.banner: FOR LAWYERS RUNNING THEIR OWN SMALL PRACTICE
06.hook: Your clients come to you after a dispute. Now become the lawyer they come to before they sign.
06.support: Add the contracts startups need, like SaaS agreements and IP licences, and learn to pitch to founders directly.

07.hook: You practise in a smaller city. Now draft contracts for startups and UK businesses without leaving it.
07.support: Learn to reach UK small businesses with a GDPR-compliant privacy policy and to pitch to startups on LinkedIn.

08.banner: FOR WOMEN LAWYERS RETURNING AFTER A FAMILY BREAK
08.hook: You took a break for your family. Now come back as a contract drafting lawyer who works from home.
08.support: Read one short lesson a day on your phone, take a quick quiz, and join live sessions in the evening.

09.banner: FOR LAWYERS WHO MOVED CITIES AFTER MARRIAGE
09.hook: You moved cities after marriage. Now become a contract drafting lawyer who can work from any city.
09.support: Contracts are drafted at a desk, not argued in a local court, so your clients can be anywhere.

10.banner: FOR INDIAN LAWYERS LIVING ABROAD WITH FAMILY
10.hook: You moved abroad with your family. Now draft contracts for businesses in India and the UK from wherever you live.
10.support: Learn to draft DPDPA and GDPR privacy policies and to reach the UK small businesses that need them.

11.banner: FOR LLB HOLDERS WORKING IN HR
11.hook: You issue offer letters and HR policies every week. Now become the lawyer companies hire to draft them.
11.support: Draft employment agreements, non-compete clauses, ESOP plans and a remote work monitoring policy.

12.banner: FOR LLB HOLDERS WORKING IN BANKING
12.hook: You know how money moves into a business. Now become the lawyer who drafts the papers behind the deal.
12.support: Draft term sheets, SAFE agreements, ESOP plans and representations and warranties clauses.

13.banner: FOR LLB HOLDERS WORKING IN CONTENT
13.hook: You already write for a living. Now become the lawyer who writes the contracts and policies businesses sign.
13.support: Draft website terms and conditions, privacy policies and cookie policies for online businesses, and publish your first legal article.

14.banner: FOR LLB HOLDERS WORKING IN SALES & OPERATIONS
14.hook: You have seen how deals get done. Now become the lawyer who drafts the contracts that close them.
14.support: Draft SaaS agreements, vendor service agreements and commercial leases, clause by clause.

15.banner: FOR LLB HOLDERS IN BPO & BACK-OFFICE JOBS
15.hook: You studied law and now work in a back office. Become the contract drafting lawyer you trained to be.
15.support: Start with the parts of a contract and build up, one document a day, to a joint development agreement.
15.popup: Give your LLB a new direction.

16.banner: FOR LAWYERS REVIEWING CONTRACTS IN LPO JOBS
16.hook: You review other people's contracts all day. Now become the lawyer who drafts them.
16.support: Move from checking clauses to writing them: NDAs, SaaS agreements, IP licences and vendor contracts.

17.banner: FOR COMPANY SECRETARIES WITH AN LLB
17.hook: You keep a company's records in order. Now become the lawyer startups hire to draft their founder and investor contracts.
17.support: Draft the papers founders sign before funding: co-founder agreements, SAFE agreements and term sheets.

18.hook: You already draft sale deeds and leases. Now become the lawyer businesses hire for their commercial contracts.
18.support: Build from commercial leases to SaaS agreements, IP licences and joint development agreements.

19.hook: You are still interning. Start becoming a contract drafting lawyer while you are in college.
19.support: Learn the parts of a contract, draft one document a day, and build a LinkedIn profile that shows your work.

20.banner: FOR LAWYERS WHO LEFT A LAW FIRM FOR FAMILY
20.hook: You left the firm for your family. Now come back as a contract drafting lawyer with your own clients.
20.support: Refresh with one contract a day and learn how to find clients among startups and on LinkedIn.
